set.body:
Scope
Implement a true jointly estimated Allen-style structured factorization, not post-hoc loading shrinkage.

Acceptance criteria
- Rank-one and rank-k objectives state row/column geometry and penalties explicitly.
- Sparse, quadratic-smooth, TV, and combined penalties are independently available on both factor sides.
- Scale, sign, gauge, zero-solution, ordering, and metric-orthogonality conventions are explicit.
- Greedy deflation and joint rank-k fitting are different estimands and APIs.
- Ordinary PCA, GPCA, sparse PCA, functional PCA, and two-way sparse-functional limits reduce correctly.
- Every block subproblem is exact or epsilon-certified.
- Fits return stationary/coordinatewise-stationary evidence unless a special global theorem actually applies.
- Reference reductions and simulation recovery tests pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar math 3: joint sparse-functional PCA and GMD estimator
